# Architectural Decisions Index

**Last updated:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Total decisions:** 0

## How to use this index

- **Before starting a task:** scan the table for decisions relevant to your domain
- **After writing an ADR:** add a row here and update "Last updated" and "Total decisions"
- **When superseding:** update the old row's status inline — don't delete it

## Index

| ID  | Title | Domain | Status | Date | Notes            |

| —   | —     | —      | —      | —    | No decisions yet |

## Status reference

- `accepted` — in effect; follow this decision
- `proposed` — written by agent, awaiting human review
- `superseded` — replaced; see linked ADR in Notes
- `deprecated` — no longer relevant
